title: 012 关雨vs封无013 交易与合作
content_zh:
012 关雨VS封无
祝大家国庆快乐，身体健康！
只见女孩跳着跳着渐渐靠近边缘，最后撞在围墙上面，但她并没有呼痛反而退后两步，停止跳舞然后上前，居然想要爬墙。
关雨忽然想起一个词——梦游症！
他赶紧跑过去，在女孩差一点就爬上围墙的时候将女孩拉住，要是爬上去的话，恐怕第二天就会多一具女尸！
看着依然在睡梦中的女孩，关雨不禁头痛，该怎么处理这家伙呢？
放着不管又怕她再次爬上去，叫醒她又怕她发出尖锐的叫声引来下面的老外。
关雨微微叹气，虽然他杀过人，但这并不意味着他就是坏人，那是任务所需。
他拉着女孩随即坐在墙角，这个位置可以让他第一时间知道有没有人上来，他之前就在这里坐着。
两手按着女孩的肩膀，让她不至于乱来，然后
他知道，只有领先别人更多，才能够把自身的优势不断的扩大！
样奖励也不高，而C-任务危险度却骤然拔高，但同样奖励也比较高。
关雨忽然停下来，他鉴于你还是一名可悲的童子鸡，这个任务就是为了你这样的屌丝准备，24小时内随意找一名异性，成为男人吧！
完成任务奖励：‘爷们’称号一个，失败惩罚：‘畜生不如’称号一个。
值得一提的是‘爷们’这个称号有额外的效果：+10力量、+10体能，而畜生不如这个称号则是：-10力量、-10体能。
关雨看着这个任务，顿时吞了吞口水，这任务也太那个……那个了吧？
他看了看身边的女孩，靠，这不是在玩弄他嘛。
这个任务太简单了，而奖励太诱人了，+10力量和+10体能，确实是非常的强大。
不过这样做不好吧？
关雨微微叹气，这个任务实在让他纠结。

他不想错过提升实力的机会，但这种任务看似简单，实际上却是在测试你的节操啊。
虽然节操什么的，扔掉就好，但现在关雨还是想要保留自己的节操。
而且这女孩，他根本不认识，而他又不想随便的将第一次给那些人尽可夫的妓女。
最后他还是关掉这个任务，继续查询其他的任务，最后他选了一个C-任务接下。
三天内凑齐一百万软妹币，奖励随机E-装备一件，失败扣除金币100。
目前为止，关雨就只有F级别的装备，最好的也就是孤狼之影，但也就只是F+级别而已。
他无法想象E-级别的装备究竟是什么样子，不过应该很给力。
至于一百万软妹币，虽然有点难，但他从头到尾都没想过用正途去凑集，手里有刀有枪，想要凑够一百万应该不算难。
不过他想不通一件事，对于系统而言，凑集一百万软妹币有什么用？
要知道未来一旦社会系统崩溃，软妹币会立即变得一文不值，而游戏发放的金币将会成为主流货币。
这一点基本上只要有前瞻眼光的人都可以预见到，莫非这个任务就是为了任务存在而任务？
也就是说，这个任务本身并不存在任何意义，只是作为任务而存在。
关雨这就想不通了，既然只是为了任务本身存在而存在，那么系统到底有什么目的？
这不是亏本买卖么？
不过这么深奥的问题，关雨无论怎么想也想不通透，最后果断放弃继续扼杀自己的脑细胞，还是务实一点想想怎么完成任务比较好。
一百万软妹币，说多确实不少，很多人一辈子都赚不了，说少，对于富人而言一百万根本不算什么。
这真是一个微妙的数字，关雨想了好几个对策，例如直接洗劫珠宝商店，然后拿到黑市换钱，例如抢（和谐）劫运钞车，例如威胁有钱人等等。
而且他记得哈根好像很有钱……
好吧，其实他一开始就打哈根的注意，毕竟哈根派杀手对付他，他不还回去他就不是关雨了。
这时候天空忽然又亮了，关雨抬头一看，顿时瞳孔猛的放大，只见天空上面写着：恭喜ID：444玩家第二位完成内测任务，奖励寿命：1，金币500，内测王气礼包一个！

第二位完成任务的玩家出现了，不过奖励却不如关雨，但关雨还是察觉到一点，那就是寿命居然也可以作为奖励，那么如果找到渠道拼命的赚取大量的寿命，是不是会一直存活下去？
就在这时候，忽然一声嘤咛，只见女孩缓缓睁开眼睛，感觉自己肩膀被人按着，女孩回过头来，一瞬间她瞳孔猛的放大，然后脑袋一歪，晕过去了……
关雨一下子傻眼了，这才想起自己脑袋上还戴着金属骷髅面具，一个刚睡醒的人回头看到这么一个画面，不被吓死才怪。
这时候又传来脚步声，关雨放下女孩，慢慢的站起来，手里顿时出现唐刀。
过了一会，一个同样穿睡衣的女孩出现，当她看到关雨的时候差点吓的尖叫，不过关雨却瞬间捂住她的嘴。
“别出声，不然……杀了你！”关雨冷冷的说道。
女孩惊恐的看着关雨手上的唐刀，这刀上面还沾染着一丝血迹，这绝对是人血。
她眼睛里面已经有泪珠在打转，惊恐的点头表示明白。
关雨慢慢的放开，道：“你朋友没事，不过她有梦游症，刚刚差点就跳楼了，希望你看好一点，再见……不对，希望不会再见。”
说完关雨就从女孩身边走过，快速的下楼。
这女孩准确说应该是少女，此时腿一软，立即坐在地上，刚刚吓死她了，不过关雨表达的意思她还是懂了，喘气过后才走到另外一个女孩旁边，看着还在睡觉的女孩，她顿时一阵好气。
关雨下楼之后就听到警车的声音，显然有人听到枪手报警了，不过警车这时候才来，效率也太低了，毕竟枪响是几小时之前的事情了。
“看来今天只能这样了。”关雨心里暗道，立即决定离开。
他走的很小心，虽然知道警车一来，哈根的人会离开，不过他本身就是十分谨慎的人，知道善始未必能够善终，自然不会大意。
无人的小巷，漆黑一片，但在关雨的眼里却明亮不少，甚至可以看到因为他的到来而惊吓的钻进下水道里的老鼠。
走了一会，关雨忽然停下，只见他前面出现一个男子。
“终于见到你了，零！”男子淡淡的说道。
关雨看到男子，顿时快速靠近男子，手里的唐刀也准备好随时斩击。
男子极为警觉，关雨稍有异动就立即开枪，不过关雨却能够看到子弹的轨迹，他头一偏身体就敏捷的避开子弹，此时他离男子还有六十米左右，以他的速度，四秒就足够靠近男子。
男子也凝重起来，他发现自己有些低估了零，只见他另一只手伸向背后取出第二把手枪，顿时他变成双枪客！

他一边退后一边快速的开枪，心里却兴奋无比，关雨现在的实力，已经可以媲美最精锐的特种兵，而反应速度更是接近人类的极限，难以想象一个没有受过严格训练的人，短短数日能变成如此强大的存在，这样的力量唯有那神秘的系统才能够赋予。
关雨快速的挥刀，每一次都准确的将子弹击落，子弹速度虽然很快，但他看得见！
不过他心里也有些焦急，这家伙子弹太刁钻了，好几次都没能用刀挡住，如果不是闪避及时的话，他已经挂彩了。
“不得不说，你真的让我大吃一惊，原本我以为凭我的实力，压制你完全没问题，但你的成长速度却再一次打破我的预测，零，有兴趣和我合作吗？”封无一边开枪一边淡淡的说道。
关雨还在靠近，只不过封无却在后退，他根本不给关雨靠近的机会。
“合作，打赢我的话，可以考虑一下。”关雨将一颗子弹切成两半，随即冷笑道，忽然他另一只手出现一把手枪，举起就对着封无射击。
封无在看到手枪的时候就瞳孔收缩，敏捷的避开，但他的反应神经和关雨相差太多，手臂顿时挂彩，同时摔倒在地。
关雨趁这个时候，立即想要冲上去拿下封无，但下一刻却猛的停下。
只见封无手里拿着一个手榴弹，脸色苍白却微笑的看着关雨，道：“我觉得我们应该谈谈，其实刚刚我就有三次机会杀死你，只不过我没有这么做。”
“第一次是你出现前的一刻，第二次和第三次没有吧？”关雨皱眉道。
确实一开始他没有发现封无，如果封无利用手枪和手榴弹配合，他确实很可能阴沟里翻船，这一点他看到手榴弹的时候就意识到了，所以才没开枪射击那手榴弹，杀死封无。
“第二次是我拿出双枪的时候，不管你信不信，我可以利用两颗子弹的碰撞改变子弹的轨迹，要击中你并不难，只不过当时我更想看到你的反应神经极限在哪里，所以才没有动手，而第三次则是现在！”封无微笑道。
关雨一愣，红光闪了一下他的眼睛，下一刻他就发现自己眉心多了一个红点，激光瞄准！
他抬头一看，远处的楼房之上，一个身穿黑色衣服的女子手里拿着狙击枪，此时已经完全锁定了他。
content_en:
012 Guan Yu VS Feng Wu
I wish everyone a happy National Day and good health!
The girl was seen dancing and getting closer to the edge, and finally hit the wall. However, she did not cry out in pain but took two steps back, stopped dancing and then stepped forward, actually trying to climb the wall.
Guan Yu suddenly remembered a word - sleepwalking!
He quickly ran over and caught the girl when she almost climbed up the wall. If she climbed up, I'm afraid there would be another female corpse the next day!
Looking at the girl who was still sleeping, Guan Yu couldn't help but have a headache. How should he deal with this guy?
I left him alone because I was afraid that she would climb up again, and when I woke her up, I was afraid that she would make a sharp scream and attract the foreigners below.
Guan Yu sighed slightly. Although he had killed people, it did not mean that he was a bad person. That was what the mission required.
He took the girl and sat in the corner. This position allowed him to know immediately if anyone came up. He had been sitting here before.
He pressed the girl's shoulders with both hands to prevent her from acting randomly, and then
He knows that only by being further ahead of others can he continuously expand his own advantages!
The reward is not high, but the danger of C-mission suddenly increases, but the reward is also relatively high.
Guan Yu suddenly stopped. Since you are still a pathetic boy, this task is prepared for losers like you. Find a person of the opposite sex within 24 hours and become a man!
The reward for completing the task: a title of 'man', and the penalty for failure: a title of 'worse than a beast'.
It is worth mentioning that the title "man" has additional effects: +10 strength, +10 physical fitness, while the title of "beast" is: -10 strength, -10 physical fitness.
Guan Yu looked at this task and swallowed his saliva immediately. This task was too...that, right?
He looked at the girl next to him, damn, she was just teasing him.
This task is too simple, and the rewards are too tempting. +10 strength and +10 physical fitness are indeed very powerful.
But isn't that bad?
Guan Yu sighed slightly, this task really troubled him.
He doesn't want to miss the opportunity to improve his strength, but this kind of task seems simple, but it is actually testing your integrity.
Although moral integrity can be thrown away, Guan Yu still wants to keep his moral integrity.
Moreover, he didn't know this girl at all, and he didn't want to give his first time to those prostitutes who could do anything for them.
In the end, he closed the task and continued to search for other tasks. Finally, he chose a C-task to take on.
If you collect one million soft girl coins within three days, you will be rewarded with a random E-equipment. If you fail, you will be deducted 100 gold coins.
So far, Guan Yu only has F-level equipment. The best one is the Lone Wolf's Shadow, but it is only F+ level.
He couldn't imagine what E-level equipment looked like, but it should be very powerful.
As for the one million soft girl coins, although it was a bit difficult, he never thought about collecting it in a legitimate way from beginning to end. With knives and guns in his hands, it shouldn't be difficult to collect one million.
But he couldn't figure out one thing. For the system, what was the use of collecting one million soft girl coins?
You must know that once the social system collapses in the future, soft girl coins will immediately become worthless, and gold coins issued by the game will become the mainstream currency.
Basically anyone with a forward-looking perspective can foresee this. Could it be that this mission is a mission for the sake of mission existence?
In other words, the task itself does not have any meaning, it just exists as a task.
Guan Yu couldn't figure it out. Since it only existed for the mission itself, what was the purpose of the system?
Isn’t this a loss-making business?
However, no matter how much he thought about such a profound question, Guan Yu couldn't figure it out. In the end, he decisively gave up and continued to kill his brain cells. It was better to be more pragmatic and think about how to complete the task.
oneOne million soft girl coins is indeed a lot. Many people will not be able to earn it in their lifetime. To the rich, one million is nothing.
This is really a subtle number. Guan Yu thought of several countermeasures, such as directly ransacking jewelry stores and then exchanging money on the black market, such as robbing (Harmony) cash transport vehicles, such as threatening rich people, etc.
And he remembered that Hagen seemed to be very rich...
Well, in fact, he took Hagen's attention from the beginning. After all, Hagen sent a killer to deal with him. If he didn't return it, he would not be Guan Yu.
At this time, the sky suddenly lit up again. Guan Yu looked up and his pupils suddenly dilated. He saw it written on the sky: Congratulations to the second player with ID: 444 for completing the internal beta task. Reward: Lifespan: 1, 500 gold coins, and a beta king gift pack!
The second player who completed the task appeared, but the reward was not as good as Guan Yu. However, Guan Yu still noticed that life span can also be used as a reward. So if he finds a way to desperately earn a lot of life span, will he survive forever?
At this moment, there was a sudden cry, and the girl slowly opened her eyes and felt her shoulders being pressed. The girl turned around, her pupils suddenly dilated, then her head tilted, and she fainted...
Guan Yu was dumbfounded for a moment, and then he remembered that he was still wearing a metal skull mask on his head. It would be strange for a person who had just woken up to look back and see such a scene, not to be frightened to death.
At this time, there were footsteps again. Guan Yu put down the girl and stood up slowly. Tang Dao suddenly appeared in his hand.
After a while, a girl also wearing pajamas appeared. When she saw Guan Yu, she almost screamed in fright, but Guan Yu instantly covered her mouth.
"Don't say anything, or else... I'll kill you!" Guan Yu said coldly.
The girl looked at the Tang knife in Guan Yu's hand in horror. There was a trace of blood on the knife. It was definitely human blood.
There were tears in her eyes, and she nodded in horror to express her understanding.
Guan Yu slowly let go and said: "Your friend is fine, but she suffers from sleepwalking. She almost jumped off the building just now. I hope you will be more cautious. Goodbye... No, I hope we won't see you again."
After saying that, Guan Yu walked past the girl and quickly went downstairs.
To be precise, this girl should be a girl. At this moment, her legs went weak and she immediately sat on the ground. She was scared to death, but she still understood what Guan Yu meant. After taking a breath, she walked to the other girl. Looking at the girl who was still sleeping, she suddenly felt good.
After Guan Yu went downstairs, he heard the sound of a police car. Apparently someone heard the gunman and called the police. However, the police car only arrived at this time, and the efficiency was too low. After all, the gunfire happened a few hours ago.
"It seems like this is all we can do today." Guan Yu thought to himself and immediately decided to leave.
He walked very carefully. Although he knew that Hagen's people would leave as soon as the police car came, he was a very cautious person. He knew that a good beginning may not lead to a good ending, so he would not be careless.
The deserted alley was pitch dark, but in Guan Yu's eyes it was much brighter, and he could even see the rats that were frightened by his arrival and crawled into the sewer.
After walking for a while, Guan Yu suddenly stopped and saw a man appearing in front of him.
"Finally I see you, Zero!" the man said lightly.
When Guan Yu saw the man, he immediately approached him quickly, with the Tang Dao in his hand ready to strike at any time.
The man was extremely vigilant. If Guan Yu made the slightest movement, he would fire immediately. However, Guan Yu could see the trajectory of the bullet. He turned his head to the side and quickly avoided the bullet. At this time, he was still about 60 meters away from the man. At his speed, four seconds would be enough to get close to the man.
The man also became serious. He realized that he had underestimated Zero. He reached his other hand behind his back and took out the second pistol. He suddenly became a double gunman!
He fired quickly while retreating, but he was extremely excited. Guan Yu's current strength, already comparable to the most elite special forces, and the reaction speed is close to the limit of human beings. It is difficult to imagine that a person without strict training can become such a powerful being in just a few days. Only the mysterious system can give such power.
Guan Yu swung the knife quickly and accurately shot down the bullet every time. Although the bullet was very fast, he could see it!
But he was also a little anxious. This guy's bullets were so tricky that he failed to block them with his knife several times. If he hadn't dodged in time, he would have lost his job.
"I have to say, you really surprised me. Originally, I thought that with my strength, I would have no problem suppressing you, but your growth rate once again exceeded my prediction. Zero, are you interested in cooperating with me?" Feng Wu said calmly while firing.
Guan Yu was still approaching, but Feng Wu was retreating. He didn't give Guan Yu a chance to get closer.
"Cooperate. If you can beat me, you can consider it." Guan Yu cut a bullet in half and then sneered. Suddenly, a pistol appeared in his other hand. He raised it and shot at Feng Wu.
When Feng Wu saw the pistol, his pupils contracted and he quickly avoided it, but his reaction was so different from Guan Yu's that his arms suddenly became red and he fell to the ground.
Guan Yu took advantage of this moment and immediately wanted to rush forward and capture Feng Wu, but stopped abruptly the next moment.
Feng Wu was seen holding a grenade in his hand, looking at Guan Yu with a pale but smiling face, and said, "I think we should talk. In fact, I had three chances to kill you just now, but I didn't do it."
"The first time was the moment before you showed up, not the second and third time, right?" Guan Yu frowned.
It is true that he did not notice Feng Wu at the beginning. If Feng Wu used a pistol and a grenade, he would probably capsize in the ditch. He realized this when he saw the grenade, so he did not shoot the grenade and kill Feng Wu.
"The second time was when I took out the two guns. Believe it or not, I can use the collision of the two bullets to change the trajectory of the bullet. It is not difficult to hit you, but at that time I wanted to see the limit of your reaction nerves, so I didn't take action. The third time is now!" Feng Wu said with a smile.
Guan Yu was stunned for a moment, a red light flashed in his eyes, and the next moment he found a red dot between his eyebrows, laser aiming!
He looked up and saw a woman in black clothes holding a sniper rifle on the building in the distance. She had completely locked onto him.
